title: Stuck on SequentialThinking MCP Server
body:
**Bug Description**
After using the sequentialthinking MCP server once, I'm forced to use sequentialthinking in that session going forward unless I clear the context. If I tell Claude Code to stop using sequentialthinking, I can't continue the session.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: xterm-ghostty
- Version: 0.2.27
- Feedback ID: b64f05d4-49c0-4d1d-b1bb-76a9ecc32c30
author: j4redux
